subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this combined issue stay open as the umbrella, or should maintainers split it between structured Control UI/Gateway reply metadata and the durable final-fallback delivery contract?
rationale: The source evidence shows real remaining work, but the permanent boundary spans UI request schema, Gateway protocol, agent runtime metadata, and channel delivery semantics, with open PR #90745 and issue #87561 already covering parts.

options.title: Split Across Existing Work
options.body: Use PR #90745 or a maintainer replacement for structured reply metadata, keep no-output semantics in issue #87561, and close this issue only after both halves are clearly tracked.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the cross-surface coordination tracker until one maintainer-approved design covers both reply metadata and no-output UX.

options.title: Defer Structured Metadata
options.body: Treat current Markdown quote behavior as sufficient for Control UI for now and keep only the final-fallback contract active.

recommendation.title: Split Across Existing Work
recommendation.body: Use PR #90745 or a maintainer replacement for structured reply metadata, keep no-output semantics in issue #87561, and close this issue only after both halves are clearly tracked.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main blame and recent area evidence cover the UI send path, Gateway schema, and runtime-context boundary that need coordination.
